head: 5c2d1ff3d66bf044830736259ce7efcd8eba1424
summary:
The fix works against real hardware. I published FsAnalyser.App.exe fresh from HEAD 5c2d1ff (src unchanged since build 1) and launched it through eng/read-window.ps1 -DefaultErrorMode, so the process error mode was 0x0 and it did not inherit this shell's 0x8003. I scanned the two real empty removable drives on this PC (E:\ and F:\, Removable, IsReady=False) and a folder path on one of them (E:\some\folder). Every run ended RootUnreadable with rootError 21 (ERROR_NOT_READY) in 7–8 ms, and the process exited 0 in about 1.3 s. Nothing blocked on a disk prompt. A temp-tree control run Completed (1 file, 2 folders, 7 bytes).

Code-level checks:
- The full default suite passed 414/414 twice.
- Fitness: all 62 rules hold. rules-parity: AGREE (12 facts, 29 patterns).
- Three mutations show the restore and guard tests catch real defects. Each file was restored afterwards with an identical hash, then touched and rebuilt.
  - (A) Drop the `using` in SynchronousIoCancel.Open: 7 Facts fail, covering the success, failure, cancel/refuse/throw, both-route and multi-thread paths.
  - (B) Make Dispose restore nothing: 9 fail, including NestedScopesUnwindInOrder and the volume-read Fact.
  - (C) Remove the scope from TryGetVolumeUsed: TheVolumeReadRunsWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack fails. This closes the critique's concern that the refactor had no test that could fail.

That discharges O-002 (restore on every exit path, LIFO nesting).

Still open:
- O-026 and O-027, both owed to build-slice, are still unfixed in the tree:
  - The name list still lacks GetCompressedFileSize, FindFirstFileName, FindFirstStream, GetFileInformationByName and CreateFileTransacted.
  - FailCriticalErrorsTests.cs:490 still has its own third `names` literal.
  - The count Fact's doc (:484) still claims completeness.

  They are minor rule-machinery findings and do not affect today's behaviour: no src calls those APIs. The merge gate will still refuse while they stand.
- Criterion 14 (handle-based calls after media is pulled mid-scan) was scoped out by the design and not checked.
- I did not show the empty-drive check can fail. The pre-fix exe was never run on E:\, because that would put a modal box on the person's screen. So 'no box' rests on the fix plus the assumption that this card reader would raise one without it.

The bug report was title-only. The assumption carried from the design is that the box comes from CreateFileW on a drive with no media, and that with the flag set the call returns 21. The real runs confirm the second part.

checks.evidence: None of the five names is in the yaml or Fact patterns. FailCriticalErrorsTests.cs:490 still holds its own `const string names` literal, and :484 still says 'Any other path call or path import there changes the count'. fitness.yaml:230 matched the completeness phrase. The only GetCompressedFileSize hit is TestNative.cs:63-64 (the EntryPoint-renamed import review m1 cited).

checks.what: Show that the empty-drive check can fail: run the pre-fix exe (uat 14acea3) with -DefaultErrorMode on E:\
checks.evidence: Not run on purpose. If the bug is real, the run puts a modal 'There is no disk in the drive' box on the person's screen while they are using the machine, and closing it would mean operating another program's window, which I may not do.

checks.what: Whole-drive C:\ scan through the published exe (criterion 13's 'equally a whole-drive C:\ scan')
checks.evidence: Not run: a C:\ scan runs the probe on all 16 logical processors for about 2-3 minutes, which breaks the half-the-processors load limit on this shared machine. The root, subfolder and probe opens on NTFS are covered by the suite, and the drive-root shape by the E:\ and F:\ runs.

checks.what: Handle-based calls after media is pulled mid-scan (criterion 14)
checks.evidence: Needs someone to remove a card from the reader physically while the scan runs. The design also scoped it out (C-014, non-material), and EveryFolderTheScanOpensIsOpenedWithTheBoxOff asserts that handle calls keep the thread's own mode (0x0).

criteria.criterion: 1. open the scan root: whole-tree scan of a temp NTFS folder; the root's listing open is guard call 1 on the scan thread
criteria.how: The full suite passed (414/414), including EveryFolderTheScanOpensIsOpenedWithTheBoxOff (call 1 reads 0x1). Mutant A kills that Fact. Real: the published exe's root open on E:\ and F:\ returned 21 into RootUnreadable without blocking. The engine-run repro (O-001) is on record and I do not re-judge it.

criteria.criterion: 2. size a file with SizeProbe: probe worker thread and a direct SizeProbe.Probe on the test thread
criteria.how: AProbeOnThisThreadOpensWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack (3 presets) and ProbesOnSeveralThreadsAtOnceEachGiveTheirThreadItsModeBack (4 dedicated threads x 2 probes) pass. Mutants A and B kill both.

criteria.criterion: 3. open a nested folder during the scan (OpenDirectory for non-root folders)
criteria.how: EveryFolderTheScanOpensIsOpenedWithTheBoxOff scans root\a\sub. Exactly 4 scan-thread calls read 0x1 (the root twice, then a and a\sub). It passes, and mutant A kills it.

BothRoutesOfAFolderOpenRunWithTheBoxOff passes: KeptLastAccess is true on one fixture and false on the other (FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES denied). Both read 0x1 inside and 0x2 after. I read the code: the scope is created before both CreateFile calls (SynchronousIoCancel.cs:352, 364, 394).

criteria.criterion: 5. give the thread its mode back: preset 0x0 before a direct Probe
criteria.how: The Theory case preset 0 passes. Mutants A and B make that case fail.

criteria.criterion: 6. give the thread its mode back: preset SEM_NOGPFAULTERRORBOX 0x2
criteria.how: The Theory case preset 2 passes (exactly 0x1 inside, 0x2 after). Mutants A and B make it fail.

criteria.criterion: 7. give the thread its mode back: caller already has SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS 0x1
criteria.how: The Theory case preset 1 passes. By nature it cannot tell a missing restore from a correct one, so NestedScopesUnwindInOrder carries the LIFO part: it passes, and mutant B kills it.

criteria.criterion: 8. restore on a failed open (access denied err 5, missing path)
criteria.how: AFailedOpenRanWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack passes, and mutants A and B kill it. Real: error 21 on E:\ and F:\ went through Open's failure path to RootUnreadable in the published exe.

ACancelledOrThrowingOpenGivesTheModeBack covers three exits: a cancel during the root open, a refusal because Cancel came first (Enter false), and an exception inside the bracket. It passes, and mutants A and B kill it.

Checked in the form review m3 accepted: 4 dedicated threads run probes concurrently, and each thread's mode equals its baseline after every probe. It passes, and mutants A and B kill it. The literal 'reused ThreadPool thread reads baseline' shape is not tested, by design: it is nondeterministic.

criteria.criterion: 11. TryGetVolumeUsed after moving onto the shared scope
criteria.how: TheVolumeReadRunsWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack passes: the present drive answers, a free letter does not, 0x1 inside both, 0x2 after. Mutant C (scope removed) kills it, so the refactor is guarded.

criteria.criterion: 12. counting rules through the guarded Open (links, hardlinks, on-disk size, long paths, unreadable folders)
criteria.how: The whole default suite ran 414/414 with 0 skipped, twice. The counting-rule tests are in the default filter; only the Network and Cloud traits are excluded.

criteria.criterion: 13. open a drive with no media (ERROR_NOT_READY 21 into Open's failure path); whole-drive vs folder scan
criteria.how: Real: the published exe, launched with process error mode 0x0, scanned E:\ and F:\ (whole drive) and E:\some\folder (folder). All three gave RootUnreadable with rootError 21 in 7-8 ms, EXIT 0 in about 1.3 s, with no blocking prompt. Caveats: a whole-drive C:\ scan through the exe was not run (load limit), and nobody has shown that the pre-fix exe raises the box on this reader, so the counterfactual is not shown.

criteria.criterion: 14. handle-based calls during the scan after media is removed (listing, GetFileInformationByHandleEx, GetVolumeInformationByHandleW)
criteria.how: Not guarded by this slice by design (C-014, non-material). It needs physical media removal mid-scan, which I cannot do, and whether to bring it into scope is an open question for a person.

obligations.evidence: Every exit of Open lies inside the `using` declared as its first statement (SynchronousIoCancel.cs:352): return Aborted, return Settle, return 0, and exceptions from Enter or from inside the bracket. The Facts pass for the normal path (presets 0, 2, 1), the failed open, cancelled/refused/throwing opens, multi-thread probes and nested scopes. Mutant A (no `using` in Open) fails 7 of them. Mutant B (Dispose restores nothing) fails 9, including NestedScopesUnwindInOrder, which shows the inner scope gives back the outer 0x1 and the outer gives back the caller's 0x2 (LIFO).

Owed to build-slice and still open at 5c2d1ff. Grep finds none of GetCompressedFileSize, FindFirstFileName, FindFirstStream, GetFileInformationByName or CreateFileTransacted in fitness.yaml, ArchitectureRulesTests.cs or FailCriticalErrorsTests.cs:490. fitness.yaml:230 and FailCriticalErrorsTests.cs:484 still carry the completeness wording.

Owed to build-slice and still open. FailCriticalErrorsTests.cs:490 still declares its own `const string names = @"(CreateFile[AW2]?|...)"`. It neither reads the patterns from ArchitectureRulesTests nor asserts they match, so rules-parity (which compares only the yaml and ArchitectureRulesTests) cannot see it drift.

not_reached: Whether the pre-fix exe (uat 14acea3) actually raises the 'There is no disk in the drive' box on E:\ or F:\ when launched with -DefaultErrorMode. Without that run, 'no box after the fix' is not shown to be caused by the fix, since this card reader might return 21 silently either way. A person can run `eng/read-window.ps1 -Exe <pre-fix exe> -Root E:\ -TimeoutSec 60 -DefaultErrorMode` once, ready to dismiss the box.
The scan thread's own error mode inside the real exe during the empty-drive open was not observed. Only the launch-time process mode (0x0) and the outcome (error 21, no hang) were.
An Explorer (double-click) launch of the exe on the empty drive. My runs used the launcher's CREATE_DEFAULT_ERROR_MODE start, which the risk spike found gives the same 0x0 process mode.
A whole-drive C:\ scan through the published exe after the fix (not run: 16-thread probe load for minutes on a shared machine).

Media pulled mid-scan so that handle-based calls (listing, GetFileInformationByHandleEx, GetVolumeInformationByHandleW) hit a no-disk condition. This needs physical removal and was scoped out of the design (C-014).
Other removable hardware (USB floppy, optical drive with no disc, other card readers). Only this PC's two empty card-reader slots were reached.
Windows 10: the project targets Windows 10 and 11, and only Windows 11 build 26200 was run.
